title: Poems
intro: I write to make sense of things I can’t fit into a design brief. These are the finished ones.

poems.title: The Silent Guides
poems.text:
I have taken solace in writing again,
To ease the heart and quite the brain.
With ink as my witness and pages to blend,

I remember listening to this; I was often told,
That books are the truest of friends to hold.
Never expect, No demands.
Just waiting for touch from a reaching hand.

They talk through their words so soft and still,
Bending their soul to your own will.
Through every dark valley and over the crest,
They offer the weary a place they can rest.

They walk with you through thick and thin,
A sanctuary found from the world and its din.
They guide you through trails,
With the wisdom that flows through piles.

A silent devotion that never shall end,
The pen and paper – my eternal best friend.

poems.title: Home…is not a place
poems.text:
They say home is not a place, It’s a feeling
And today I lost mine, there is no belonging
My home is lost,
You are lost.
The sand drips, from my grips.
The more I try, more I lose.
You look right through me,
You walk right past me.
Like I am looking at a stranger,
You sit in the same room but you don’t notice my sobs.

My heart broke into million pieces,
The day you slept peacefully,
And I lied beside you crying all night.
I lost hope that anything could be alright.

I have lost a lot in life,
But I never thought I will lose you too.
It was always you or nothing,
You were my everything
You were the centre of my life,
You were my life.
But I; even after being your wife,
Was I just a convenient thing?

I am sitting here wondering,
When will you come?
Or will you ever?
How does it feel to lose me?
Does your heart break too?
Or is it just me?

poems.title: Alone
poems.text:
I am here sitting in a crowded room,
Everyone is talking and having fun.
Laughter is loud, Celebrations in full bloom,
And I am still alone,
Felling like I don’t belong.

My eyes are looking for only you,
I look at the empty seat beside me.
For what is success without you to celebrate with,
If the seat beside me is not taken by you.

I could be surrounded by millions now,
But all my heart wants is you.
All the songs playing are just noise,
My ears are longing to hear your voice.

I am waiting patiently for you to come,
Hold my hand, ease my pain.
This huge victory doesn’t feel like I won,
Without you its all in vain.

poems.title: You
poems.text:
When you are not here to share my days and nights,
My life is so incomplete,
For you are my heart and my soul,
The oneness I had known to seek.

Without you, I merely exist from day to day;
With you I know I will find,
All that I have been searching for,
My eternal piece of mind.

But I am forced to wonder now,
If you feel the same way
Our promise was to hold each others hand
Without questioning when, what, and how
But here I am sitting in quiet awry
Wondering is it the same now?

poems.title: Don’t
poems.text:
I want to talk but I won’t
Because I am scared if you don’t
Feel the same as I do for you
Whatever you say won’t change my feeling
No matter what you put me through

I remember every word you say,
But I don’t know if you’ll stay.
I don’t want to but I am aware
Deep down in my heart I know,
I have to be without you.

Its only you who can change it either way,
Or don’t hold me hand if you’re going to leave it.
Don’t hug me if it doesn’t come from your heart.
Don’t touch me if you just have to pass by in the future.
Don’t love me if you are not going to stay forever.

poems.title: Last Words – Part 1
poems.text:
I loved you with everything in me,
Dreamed about our future; a world of three.
Looked beautiful for you,
Wished the best for you,
Only to let you bring out the worst in me.

Always saw you as a partner,
Felt complete with you beside me,
Spent my birthday with you at your work,
And you choose to be away on valentines leaving me hurt.

The driven, ambitious disciplined girl is long gone,
The day you forced me to change my dreams I was built on.
I was fool, chasing you after near and far,
There you were breaking my heart with countless scars.

poems.title: Last Words – Part 2
poems.text:
You never appreciated my love and sacrifices,
But you never missed a chance to belittle me on my face.
The promises you made, for life long to keep me safe,
Turned out to be all fake.

Willing to forgive even after all the agony,
Ready to give another chance to our love story.
Start with a clean slate,
Be it whatever, together we face.

But now I have no reason to breathe,
I not feeling my heart beating.
All I want is to sleep and never wake up again,
For I have nothing left in me to bear this pain.

I wish to go to a place where you cannot hurt me,
Maybe I have already let go off and set you free.

poems.title: Moments
poems.text:
All I want is to sleep and never wake up again,
For I have nothing left in me to bear this pain.
My soul, every bit of it is destroyed;
You took it away and left me dishevelled.
I don’t feel broken apart anymore,
I don’t feel the ache in my hear anymore.

I wished things were so differently,
Sadly, this is what you have made of me.
My life is better this way,
Instead of getting hurt day by day.

So, I kiss our memories goodbye,
Leaving behind your torture and lies,
Our memories together were precious not few,
But I cherished them more than you ever knew.

poems.title: Speak Now
poems.text:
I am holding my feelings tight,
Seems like I can’t win this fight.
I just want to make everything alright,
I keep praying for this all day and night.

If you could see what I am going through,
You will know my love for you is true.
If you love me too, just the way I do,
Please give me a clue or two.

Losing is you like this is a hard thing for me to do,
Hoping and wondering, you will feel the same way too.
But I can’t read your mind if you want me too,
Whatever it is, I will be here, waiting for you.

poems.title: Heartbreak
poems.text:
My eyes hurt
They feel heavy
But my heart feels heavier
It has been like this for a while now
They say it’s a heartbreak
Then why does my whole body hurt?

The memories won’t go away,
How am I supposed to let them be burnt?
I was hoping my tears would dry,
But every time I think of letting go,
The emptiness in my stomach just grows.

I imagined my life my life with you.
I shared my dreams with you.
There were days you couldn’t resist talking to me.
When you found me just to tell me you love me.
Now you ignore my messages for days.

I am scarred and terrified.
‘Us’ seems to be a far off dream now.
Our future is vague or…
Do we even have a future now?

poems.title: Thank You
poems.text:
Thank you for loving me at my worst,
After the ones who couldn’t love me at my best.

Thank you for pulling me out of that gloomy cloud,
Making me hear the desires of my heart,
When the noises around me were so loud.

I am such a gauche to keep up with,
I tag along my doubts.
I think too much and worry even more.
But you were there to calm my nerves.
Bringing me the joys of life,
I never knew I deserved.

I was the storm, the worst of its kind.
You were the calm, the best of its kind.
I was a disaster.
But you hugged me tighter,
Even when I was a disaster.

I am living the life of my dreams,
And you are here telling me to chase more.
When it feels like I am deep in the ocean,
I look at you waiting for me at the shore.

And then I wake up from this beautiful dream,
Hoping to see my dreams comes alive.
But I am instead faced with reality,
That this is life.

poems.title: Life…happens
poems.text:
People become distant.
Things go awry.
There is less to smile about,
And more to worry.

The constant hustle,
Of making things happen.
The constant bustle,
Of reaching your goals.

Too much rush.
So many dreams.
Wanting to bail out,
On the mind that screams.

So much to achieve,
So less to believe.
A handful of people,
Ready to deceive.

The flurried feeling in the stomach,
When plans fail.
Nothing makes sense,
All you want is to wail.

That’s when life happens,
In between those moments.
When you were too worried about,
What’s wrong what’s right.

poems.title: Heartaches
poems.text:
Do you know that feeling?
That soft, aching sensation in your heart
That slowly settles in your chest

When you knew something inside you broke
But it wasn’t beyond repair.
Just quietly left in despair.

You tell yourself
Maybe you missed something
A sign, a plea, an impression
But it was just a choice they made
To let you go

Something beautiful was broken.
Not by fate. Not by storm too strong.
But by someone who chose not to hold on

When you rewind on to memories
You revisit sweet moments
But conversations are now clouded
With half truths and unfinished sentences

poems.title: First love
poems.text:
You met her when her guards were up.
You worked your way into her life.
Made your way into her heart
Meddled into those careful silences.

She opened up like a window that never closed
She trusted you like a faith that didn’t ask questions
She let her guards down to share her fears
She changed her dreams to match yours

You loved her when she was soft
You cared for her when her heart was unlocked
You made her believe in a world where love exists
You reassured her that this is not a dream.

Then came the quiet you didn't explain,
The slow pulling back of your hands.
The silences that once felt safe
Now stretched like distances with no end.

And now she guards a different kind of silence,
Not careful but bruised, and learned the hard way.
She knows what it means to be truly seen,
And what it costs when someone looks away.

She looked for you in familiar places,
In the warmth you used to leave behind.
Still wearing the dreams she'd changed for you,
Still searching for the world you said was true.

poems.title: Cognizant
poems.text:
Then you rewrote her,
line by line,
day by day
And now you call her toxic

You reminded her of
Her softness,
Her boundaries
Her heart
Her self respect
Every chance you got

She learned – not to love but to protect
She learned – not to dream but to dare
She learned – not to chase but to respect
She learned – not to beg you to stay but to leave with dignity

Now she stays cognizant
Double checking on love
Every time your words fall on her ears
Every time you say you love her.

Your love might stay with her
But your words definitely will
Those small lies
Those fake promises
That cut quietly
Ripped her apart

She still loves you
But she protects herself first.

poems.title: Lost
poems.text:
She lost her spark
Somewhere between trying and loving

It didn’t leave all at once
Just faded into darkness
Little by little
Like a dimming bulb
On a dark street
That no one notices

She doesn’t laugh the same now
She doesn’t dance to music
She isn’t the same as she was
When she was around you

But she often sits with herself
Remembering that version of herself
Where she was made of small joys
Sunlight, rain, and rainbows

She still wakes up but is not awaken anymore
She breathes the same but doesn’t live anymore

poems.title: Losing you
poems.text:
I never thought,
Silence could grow this loud.
That something so empty
Could echo this much

You used to be where I ran
When the world felt heavy
The voice that made everything feel light
Without even trying

I trusted you
In ways I didn’t understand
Handed you pieces of me
Like they were safe in your hands

I kept loving that version of you that saw me
Even when you started seeing right through me
I was still reaching out again and again
Without realising that you stopped long back

It wasn’t the silence that broke me
It was staying close to someone who was already gone
Because losing you wasn’t the hardest part
Losing myself trying not to was.

poems.title: Silence
poems.text:
The quiet between us
Didn’t just arrive
It grey slowly
Like a shadow but in the dark
So you never saw it coming

The trust between us
Was a fragile glass
Clear, careless, and crisp
Believing it wouldn’t shatter
I was naïve enough

The distance between us
Didn’t start with miles
It started with pauses
Where replies used to live with silences
That stayed longer than they should

I was there.
At the same place
In the same way
While you found ways to let go
To lean away

poems.title: A Dream, a wish
poems.text:
She wrapped herself in a blanket, laying on her side
His hands slide across her tiny body
With whispers of quiet voice
This moment is precious, her world feels soft
Like a warm blanket, where nothing could harm her

She feels it in every moment,
A rare unwavering grace
What it feels like to be chosen daily
To be the centre of someone’s whole world
And to be someone’s safe space unswervingly.

She reaches out to embrace that moment
Certain this is real, certain this will stay
But the sunlight suddenly feels colder
No arm around her, no warmth to fill

And she opened her eyes slowly
To face the façade of her dreams
The silence whispers of what her heart already knew
A dream she wished she held a little longer onto.

poems.title: My home
poems.text:
I built a home on shifting sand
And called it solid ground
Holding tight to a ghostly hand
Where no real warmth was found

I kept showing up at a door
That was already closed
Blinded by the promises from the start
I spent my time guarding a hollow port

I poured myself into the gap
Between what was real and what was not
Chasing a non-existent reverie
For the hope only I held onto for so long

I just wish you spoke the truth
If your feelings began to fade
To save the faith I lost in loving you
And the forlorn plans of future I made

poems.title: How could you…?
poems.text:
How could your heart become so cold?
To leave me standing there in pouring rain.
Why were you so careless with my soul?
Leaving me scattered like a puzzle pieces you once made whole.

Did you ever stop, even for a fleeting breath?
To see what you did felt a little like death.
Or was I never high enough upon your list of gold?
To deserve a little kindness before you turned so cold.

You saw how I my guard was on the floor for you.
How I gave you every key and opened every door.
I trusted you with secrets I was afraid to even say,
And you used each one of them in a twisted way.

The silence is a gavel and the verdict is the pain.
As I try to find a reason in the middle of this stain.
Why did you do this to me is the only question I keep asking
But the silence is the only answer I get in return.

poems.title: One last time
poems.text:
Can we meet one final time – just you & me?
No to restart, not to replay what used to be.
Not to fall back in that familiar old embrace.
Just with honesty, at last, face to face.

Are you happy not knowing how I am?
Are you able to sleep at nights?
Knowing how restless I am?
How do your nights stay quiet & light,
When I can’t even close my eyes at night?

I ask these questions every day, every dawn;
Like I am chasing a truth that keeps moving on.
Why does it feel like I was just a chapter in your story?
When I was treating you as the main character of my story?

So, will you meet me one last time?
No promises. No ‘us’ to revive.
Just the truth.
So I can finally survive.
Because I don’t want to die a little everyday,
For the rest of my life.

poems.title: Loving you
poems.text:
I lost myself in loving you.
Every fight we had, every time things got difficult.
I told myself, you were overwhelmed;
That you were trying, just like me.
Those words you said weren’t meant to hurt me.

Every time something felt wrong,
I learned a quitter way to shrink.
Every time it felt like my words fell on deaf ears,
I stopped myself from expressing anymore.

But I stayed.
God, I stayed.
Not because it didn’t hurt,
But because I was so certain
That if I loved you a little more;
That if I stayed a little more;
You’ll see the love I have for you in my heart.

But now I wonder.
If you ever noticed all the times,
I swallowed my feelings whole.
Or maybe you just got used to it.
Like you get used to a door.
That opens and closes at your will.
So, you stopped noticing it’s there.

And that’s the part that still unravels me.
Not your ignorance.
Not your harsh words.
But the fact that I was just a habit,
Not a person for you anymore;
Who has come to believe,
That asking to be loved is asking for too much.

poems.title: Memories
poems.text:
I often get lost,
In the beautiful memories we made.
The days we spent playing video games.
And the nights our favourite movies played.

The long walks we took without a care.
When holding my hand was you will.
Even when the views around us were better,
For you I was the one to look at.

The walls of that house must still echo with our laughter.
The meals we cooked together in the evening lights.
Th fairy lights we put up on the windows.
The chairs we built together on rainy nights.

I get lost in those memories,
More often than I know I should.
Maybe I could just go back to those times.
And live those moments again,
Just once.
Just briefly.
Just enough.

poems.title: Memories of us
poems.text:
I keep our memories,
Folded like old letters,
Tucked away under my pillow.
Close enough to feel,
But still too fragile to unfold again.

There are too many.
Sweet, innocent, and loving.
But somehow;
They are overshadowed,
With the bitter ones now.

I want to be selective.
I want to revisit only the sweet ones.
I am selfish.
I want to forget the pain.
I want to only remember the love.
The love that I never regret.

But the door doesn’t open backwards,
And that’s a new learning;
That holding onto what was,
Will bring the old memories back;
But not just the sweet ones.

And that’s the ache that doesn’t leave me.
Not the love, Never the love.
